title: WP-ARCH-B: G04 DESIGN evidence semantics (architecture / adr / data-model / api-contract / operability-design)
objective: Enforce Gate 04 by implementing the DESIGN-side deterministic controls of the frozen badf-architecture contract inside the canonical gate. Give the five G04 evidence types per-type rules in validate_evidence with the architecture baseline as the spine the other four are consistent with; ship examples/gate-dossier.G04.json (CI-validated) and a G03->G04 pair-acceptance; advance badf-architecture DESIGNED->IMPLEMENTED.
business_value: Turns G04 -- the architecture gate -- from pass-on-names into deterministic refusals for undirected/unintended relationships, boundary crossings without an interface, unclassified trust-boundary data flows, unallocated NFRs, and operability that omits failure/recovery. The architecture baseline becomes the machine-checked source of truth, not a diagram.
in_scope: check_architecture / check_adr / check_data_model / check_api_contract / check_operability_design in badf_gate.py + registration in EVIDENCE_RULES
examples/gate-dossier.G04.json + its five evidence/artifact pairs; CI validates it
tests/test_badf_g04.py (failing-first) + a G03->G04 pair-acceptance in tests/test_badf_advance.py
mutation; own G07 self-dossier; doctrine section in GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md
out_of_scope: WP-ARCH-C: the ASSURE substrate (dependency graph, cycles, boundary rules, ADR compliance, baseline/observed binding; acceptance controls 13-18)
any scripts/badf_architecture.py executable (ARCH-I11: no second gate)
any change to G04 authority or lifecycle.json gate order
later gates G05+ -- one WP each
acceptance_criteria: a relationship without a direction or without an intent is refused
an element outside every declared boundary is refused
a boundary-crossing relationship not through a declared interface is refused
a trust-boundary data flow with no classification is refused
an ALLOCATED NFR with no mechanism or no fitness obligation is refused; an NFR with no disposition is refused
a fitness obligation with no property or no scope is refused
an ADR with no affected element or no decision driver, or referencing an unknown requirement/NFR, is refused
a data-model entity whose owner boundary is unknown, an api-contract interface that is unknown/unversioned, are refused
operability-design missing failure modes/recovery/observability is refused
a C4-view element absent from the baseline is refused
an instance at G03/APPROVED advances to G04/APPROVED on a valid G04 dossier
badf-architecture registry status is IMPLEMENTED with a real digest
mutation kills; compose green both shapes; PyYAML-absent suite green

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; the next WP reconciles it. Reuses the G01/G02/G03 substrate -- no new validator module (ARCH-I11). Advances badf-architecture to IMPLEMENTED; the contract test's not-implemented-yet assertions flip to implemented in this WP. VALIDATED still requires WP-ARCH-C (ASSURE, controls 13-18) with mutation.
